info.description:
Returns the default columns for the given filter. Currently logged in user will be used as
 the user making such request.
info.title: JIRA 7.6.1

requests.description: Returns an application property.
requests.name: GET /api/2/application-properties

requests.description: Returns the properties that are displayed on the "General Configuration > Advanced Settings" page.
requests.name: GET /api/2/application-properties/advanced-settings

requests.description: Modify an application property via PUT. The "value" field present in the PUT will override the existing value.
requests.name: PUT /api/2/application-properties/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Returns all ApplicationRoles in the system. Will also return an ETag header containing a version hash of the
 collection of ApplicationRoles.
requests.name: GET /api/2/applicationrole

requests.description:
Updates the ApplicationRoles with the passed data if the version hash is the same as the server.
 Only the groups and default groups setting of the role may be updated. Requests to change the key
 or the name of the role will be silently ignored. It is acceptable to pass only the roles that are updated
 as roles that are present in the server but not in data to update with, will not be deleted.
requests.name: PUT /api/2/applicationrole

requests.description: Returns the ApplicationRole with passed key if it exists.
requests.name: GET /api/2/applicationrole/{key}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Updates the ApplicationRole with the passed data. Only the groups and default groups setting of the role may be updated. Requests to change the key or the name of the role will be silently ignored.

Optional: If versionHash is passed through the If-Match header the request will be rejected if not the same as server
requests.name: PUT /api/2/applicationrole/{key}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Returns the meta information for an attachments, specifically if they are enabled and the maximum upload size
 allowed.
requests.name: GET /api/2/attachment/meta

requests.description: Remove an attachment from an issue.
requests.name: DELETE /api/2/attachment/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns the meta-data for an attachment, including the URI of the actual attached file.
requests.name: GET /api/2/attachment/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Tries to expand an attachment. Output is human-readable and subject to change.
requests.name: GET /api/2/attachment/{id}/expand/human
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Tries to expand an attachment. Output is raw and should be backwards-compatible through the course of time.
requests.name: GET /api/2/attachment/{id}/expand/raw
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns auditing records filtered using provided parameters
requests.name: GET /api/2/auditing/record

requests.description: Store a record in Audit Log
requests.name: POST /api/2/auditing/record

requests.description: Returns all system avatars of the given type.
requests.name: GET /api/2/avatar/{type}/system
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates temporary avatar
requests.name: POST /api/2/avatar/{type}/temporary
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the cropping instructions of the temporary avatar.
requests.name: POST /api/2/avatar/{type}/temporaryCrop
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns the keys of all properties for the comment identified by the key or by the id.
requests.name: GET /api/2/comment/{commentId}/properties
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Removes the property from the comment identified by the key or by the id. Ths user removing the property is required
 to have permissions to administer the comment.
requests.name: DELETE /api/2/comment/{commentId}/properties/{propertyKey}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Returns the value of the property with a given key from the comment identified by the key or by the id. The user who retrieves
 the property is required to have permissions to read the comment.
requests.name: GET /api/2/comment/{commentId}/properties/{propertyKey}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Sets the value of the specified comment's property.

You can use this resource to store a custom data against the comment identified by the key or by the id. The user who stores the data is required to have permissions to administer the comment.
requests.name: PUT /api/2/comment/{commentId}/properties/{propertyKey}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Create a component via POST.
requests.name: POST /api/2/component

requests.description: Delete a project component.
requests.name: DELETE /api/2/component/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a project component.
requests.name: GET /api/2/component/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Modify a component via PUT. Any fields present in the PUT will override existing values. As a convenience, if a field is not present, it is silently ignored.

If leadUserName is an empty string ("") the component lead will be removed.
requests.name: PUT /api/2/component/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns counts of issues related to this component.
requests.name: GET /api/2/component/{id}/relatedIssueCounts
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Returns the information if the optional features in JIRA are enabled or disabled. If the time tracking is enabled,
 it also returns the detailed information about time tracking configuration.
requests.name: GET /api/2/configuration

requests.description: Returns a full representation of the Custom Field Option that has the given id.
requests.name: GET /api/2/customFieldOption/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of all dashboards, optionally filtering them.
requests.name: GET /api/2/dashboard

requests.description: Returns the keys of all properties for the dashboard item identified by the id.
requests.name: GET /api/2/dashboard/{dashboardId}/items/{itemId}/properties
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Removes the property from the dashboard item identified by the key or by the id. Ths user removing the property is required
 to have permissions to administer the dashboard item.
requests.name: DELETE /api/2/dashboard/{dashboardId}/items/{itemId}/properties/{propertyKey}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Returns the value of the property with a given key from the dashboard item identified by the id.
 The user who retrieves the property is required to have permissions to read the dashboard item.
requests.name: GET /api/2/dashboard/{dashboardId}/items/{itemId}/properties/{propertyKey}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Sets the value of the specified dashboard item's property.

You can use this resource to store a custom data against the dashboard item identified by the id. The user who stores the data is required to have permissions to administer the dashboard item.
requests.name: PUT /api/2/dashboard/{dashboardId}/items/{itemId}/properties/{propertyKey}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a single dashboard.
requests.name: GET /api/2/dashboard/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of all fields, both System and Custom
requests.name: GET /api/2/field

requests.description: Creates a custom field using a definition (object encapsulating custom field data)

requests.name: PUT /api/2/filter/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
